dedupe_keys.name: periodic dynamic induction control of wind farms proving the potential in simulations and wind tunnel experiments

description: Frederik, Joeri Alexis and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented control strategy varies a turbine induction factor periodically using a sinusoidal input. Scaled wind-tunnel experiments provide a proof of concept for power gains, while damage-equivalent-load effects are evaluated separately in simulation. The source reports a limited increase in those loads on the excited turbine under the examined conditions. This establishes a bounded dynamic-induction method, not full-scale field validation or an image-correlation technique. The wind-tunnel data retain a separate dataset identity; source-code availability is unspecified. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
